serve_action_engine: run the action engine serve command to host an action registry on a local server
register_action_engine_host: register an action engine host with a display name and description using the register command
parse_cli_args: parse command line arguments for the action engine CLI including serve register and create-api-key commands
run_sync_main: run the action engine CLI entry point synchronously using asyncio run with parsed arguments
setup_action_engine: initialize the action engine environment and configure logging before dispatching to the selected command
